description.en: Starts a named in-match countdown timer running for the given duration (e.g. used to time a temporary floor hazard).
Duration (in frames or seconds) for the timer to run.
True once the timer has been started; null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Start a named timer for a temporary match hazard
CMND_BTL_SET_TIMER("timer", 300);
